finding.expected: Route every prospective predecessor-bearing REMEDIATION identity consumed by Unified State through the existing canonical P3A predecessor validator before frontier derivation. Unexpected, alias, conflicting, malformed, or identity-inconsistent predecessor fields must fail closed to MALFORMED_CANONICAL_STATE. Preserve the explicitly bounded legacy no-predecessor compatibility path without creating a second predecessor grammar.
finding.issue: P3C1 consumes prospective predecessor-bearing REMEDIATION RUN data as a raw mapping and passes that mapping into CorrectionFrontier advancement without first applying the canonical P3A four-field predecessor parser. The P3B frontier helper accepts the canonical keys from a Mapping but does not reject unexpected/alias keys. Therefore a malformed predecessor containing a valid source_run_id plus an extra or conflicting alias such as run_id can be interpreted by Unified State even though canonical publication rejects the same predecessor shape. Unified State and publication can consequently disagree on exact predecessor identity instead of the malformed lineage failing closed.
